title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 39
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 39: the breach in the city wall, the capture of Zedekiah at Jericho, and the word spoken for Ebedmelech the Ethiopian.

questions.text: When was a breach made in the city?
questions.explanation: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.

answers.text: In the ninth year of Zedekiah, in the tenth month
In the first year of Nebuchadnezzar, in the first month
In the fifth year of Jehoiakim, in the ninth month
In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month

questions.text: Where did the princes of the king of Babylon sit when they came in?
questions.explanation: All the princes of the king of Babylon came in and sat in the middle gate.

answers.text: In the middle gate
In the court of the guard
In the king's garden
At the entry of the new gate

questions.text: How did Zedekiah and the men of war go out of the city when they saw the princes of Babylon?
questions.explanation: They fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, through the gate between the two walls, and he went out toward the Arabah.

answers.text: By day, with all the people following them
Over the broken-down wall on the north side
By night, through the gate between the two walls
Through the middle gate, past the princes

questions.text: Where did the army of the Chaldeans overtake Zedekiah?
questions.explanation: The army of the Chaldeans pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho.

answers.text: By the great waters of Gibeon
In the plains of Jericho
At Ramah, among the captives
In the land of Benjamin

questions.text: Where was Zedekiah brought to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: They brought Zedekiah up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he pronounced judgment on him.

answers.text: To Tahpanhes in the land of Egypt
To Mizpah in the land of Benjamin
To Anathoth in the land of Judah
To Riblah in the land of Hamath

questions.text: What did the king of Babylon do to Zedekiah himself at Riblah?
questions.explanation: The king of Babylon killed Zedekiah's sons in Riblah before his eyes, and he put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.

answers.text: He put out his eyes and bound him in fetters
He killed him with the sword before the nobles
He made him governor over the cities of Judah
He sent him back to Jerusalem in peace

questions.text: What did the Chaldeans do in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The Chaldeans burned the king's house and the houses of the people with fire, and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

answers.text: They set guards at every gate and left the city whole
They carried away the gates to Babylon
They burned the houses and broke down the walls
They tore down only the house of the king

questions.text: Whom did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard leave in the land of Judah, and what did he give them?
questions.explanation: Nebuzaradan left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

answers.text: The princes of Judah, and gave them the city gates
The poor of the people, and gave them vineyards and fields
The men of war, and gave them the king's house
The priests, and gave them Yahweh's house

questions.text: What did Nebuchadnezzar command Nebuzaradan concerning Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Nebuchadnezzar commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard to take Jeremiah and take care of him, to do him no harm, but to do to him even as he told him.

answers.text: To take care of him and do him no harm
To bind him in chains with the captives
To bring him to Riblah for judgment
To keep him shut up in the court of the guard

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Jeremiah to say to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would surely save Ebedmelech, who would not fall by the sword but escape with his life, because he had put his trust in him.

answers.text: That he would be carried away to Babylon
That he would be made governor in the land
That he would be saved and escape with his life
That he would never see this city again
